name: dropify-mcp
description: Instant restock and drop alerts for official artist and brand merch stores.
long_description: Look up the official merch stores Dropify tracks for an artist or brand, then get the page where restock and drop alerts are set. Read-only, straight from Dropify's public API.

tools.name: find_brand
tools.description: Fuzzy-match an artist or brand name against Dropify's tracked brands.

tools.name: official_stores
tools.description: List the official stores Dropify tracks for a brand.

tools.name: restock_alert_link
tools.description: Get the Dropify page where restock and drop alerts are set for a brand.
